Future<void> run(items, read) async {
 for (final user in batch) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait([read(user), notify(user)]);
 }
 for (final user in receive(queue, 10)) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await (read(user), notify(user)).wait;
 }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (final piece in parts) { await Future.wait(piece.map(read)); }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (var piece in parts) { await Future.wait(piece.map(read)); }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (final List<String> piece in parts) { await Future.wait(piece.map(read)); }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (final piece in parts) { await piece.map(read).wait; }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (final piece in grouped.parts) { await Future.wait(piece.map(read)); }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (final piece in records) { await piece.wait; }
 for (final piece in parts) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(other.map(read));
 }
 const one = 1;
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (final piece in split(items, one)) { await Future.wait(piece.map(read)); }
 for (final piece in List.generate(count, (i) => items.skip(i * 1).take(1))) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(piece.map(read));
 }
 final individual = List.generate(count, (i) => items.skip(i * 1).take(1));
 for (final piece in individual) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(piece.map(read));
 }
 final singles = split(items, 1);
 for (final piece in singles) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(piece.map(read));
 }
 for (final piece in split(items, 1)) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(piece.map(read));
 }
 for (final piece in parts) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await inspect(piece);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(piece.map(read));
 }
 for (final piece in parts) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(piece.map(read));
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(piece.map(notify));
 }
 for (final piece in parts) {
  for (final item in piece) {
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
   await (read(item), notify(item)).wait;
  }
 }
